name: Majide
personality: Violent, jail-hardened troublemaker who loves booze, women, fighting and being strong.
story: Majide has been a notorious thug since his youth and has spent many days in jail for violent incidents. He enters the Heroic Games hoping to win and become ruler of the streets. On Cai's route he joins at Renown 5 and Support 2 if you answer his recruitment question correctly.

personalSkill.name: Hellbent Axe
personalSkill.effect: Str+3 when equipped with an axe.

tierNotes: KeenGamer: C tier (early axe unit on Cai's route, but 20% Spd and 10% Res). Pocket Tactics: C tier.

why: Lowest Support requirement of any route: 2 here vs Dietrich 3, Theodora 3, Leda 3.
recruit.tip: Answer his question three times before he accepts.

path: Pugilist (Part II detour: Gauntlet B, Attack, Get Back)
build.notes: Joins at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class; benched in Part I. Arena Axe B, Sword B and Gauntlet (Warrior Training covers all three). Part II: Army Training to Lv 34 in Gladiator, Brigand in Ch 2 (Regroup), Pugilist once Gauntlet is C to train Gauntlet B, then Warrior for Practiced Art (late Part II or Part III). Battlemaster in Part III.

guide.summary: Benched in Part I. Warrior grows HP 85 and Str 70 on him, and Hellbent Axe adds Str +3 with axes, but his slow Warrior rank (Gauntlet B) only rises by fighting, so in Part II he climbs Brigand and Pugilist first. Spd 20: he trades in single big hits.
guide.playstyle: Break armor on player phase with the Hammer; take enemy phase only against physical foes. Res grows 5 to 10%: keep him away from mages.
keys: Bench in Part I: Arena Heavy and Infantry Training for Axe B and Sword B.
End of Ch 12: equip the Hammer and the Bolt Gem. Only the equipped weapon carries into Part II; Part II's Iron +3 weapons cover his everyday axe.
Part II Ch 1: Army Training in Gladiator, fight with gauntlets; Brigand in Ch 2.
Pugilist once Gauntlet is C (Gauntlet +2 per fight, Attack, Get Back), Warrior once Gauntlet is B.
Master Practiced Art in Warrior: Hit +10 on arts.
watch: Gauntlet is his bottleneck: train it at Arena Warrior Training (Sword, Axe, Gauntlet).
Dex 30: check Hit before every axe swing.

Weight: Hammer 20 + Bolt Gem 5 = 25, player phase only: he gets doubled holding it, so end turns with a lighter axe (Iron Axe +3 10 + gem = 15; Silver Axe 9 + gem = 14). Extra weight is the gem's 5, inside the 6 cap. Credna's Mallet 14 + gem = 19 in Part III. Charm growth 5: no Charm Mask.

Inventory: Part II is 6/6 (issued Iron Axe +3, Hammer, Hand Axe, Iron Gauntlets, Bolt Gem, Concoction). The Ch 1 Hammer +1 replaces the Hammer; if Part II also issues gauntlets, drop the carried pair.

tips: Joins at about Lv 15 already in a Beginner class. If it isn't Gladiator, take the Gladiator exam (Gauntlet D, Axe D, Sword D) on a Beginner License before Part II Ch 1 Army Training.
Army Training in Gladiator: HP 75, Str 60 on Majide (Hunter would give Spd 30, Dex 40 but needs Bow D).
Recruit cost: Support 2, Renown 5, answer his question three times. Recruit him anyway: Part II needs the numbers.
Barter the Hammer (Roca x2 + Zamir x1) and buy the Da Mina Axe anyway; lend the Bolt Gem to a deployed unit and put it back on him at the end of Ch 12.

guide.alt: Dreadnought instead of Warrior in Part II: Arena Heavy Training covers Axe B, Spear B and Heavy D in one course, so he could take it in Ch 2, but he loses gauntlets and Battlemaster still needs Gauntlet A. If inn auto-training does raise Gauntlet on the bench, skip ahead: Pugilist in Ch 2, Warrior as soon as Gauntlet is B.

decisions.pick: Gladiator on recruit, no Part I exam
decisions.why: C and D on every tier list, and his Warrior rank (Gauntlet) can't be trained in the Arena. Magic, Ji and the Hammer already cover armor.

decisions.topic: Climb Brigand, Pugilist, Warrior in Part II
decisions.pick: Brigand (Ch 2), Pugilist once Gauntlet is C, Warrior once Gauntlet is B
decisions.why: Free Licenses: each class trains the next one's rank while Army Training sets his level.
